```artifact
## Decision Table Test Suite for U28_misc

| Condition | Action | Expected Result |
|---|---|---|
| Chemist/Lab Id exists | Edit/Update | Chemist/Lab details updated successfully |
| Chemist/Lab Id doesn't exist | Exception | "Chemist or Lab does not exist" |
| Open prescriptions exist | Exception | "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete" |
| Symptom Code exists | Edit/Update | Symptom details updated successfully |
| Symptom Code doesn't exist | Exception | "Symptom does not exist" |
| Patient Id generated | Display | Patient Profile screen displayed with generated Patient Id |
| Consultation/Appointment request raised | Confirmation message displayed | Consultation/Appointment request created successfully |
| Prescription report downloaded | Confirmation message displayed | Prescription report downloaded |

```
